author.identity_statement: Cedar Meridian is the stable, package-distinct author identity for this independently authored v9 oracle.

artifact_binding.canonical_byte_rule: The SHA-256 binds the exact repository file bytes as authored; no semantic reserialization is implied.

active_schema_bindings.bound_invariant: A transcript with nonempty contradiction_evidence_ids contains exactly one proposal.

ground_truth_method.method: Manual clean-room derivation from accepted product semantics, ADR-0034, public evaluation rules, and the active closed schemas.
ground_truth_method.source_cases: Neutral synthetic source statements were authored specifically for v9. Raw source-producer tuples remain separate from later analysis-run consumer tuples, source production always leaves local applicability not evaluated, and every consumer applicability decision is derived from a bounded answer-free local input identified in the oracle.
ground_truth_method.source_opposition: The contradicted source case retains one self-contained visible opposing statement with an independent source identity, explicit availability, exact UTF-8 byte count, SHA-256, and references that resolve to the same artifact ID without treating it as the cited passage.
ground_truth_method.candidate_cases: Neutral selected contexts and evidence relationships were authored specifically for v9. Supporting, insufficient, directly opposing, unavailable, and explicitly indeterminate evidence lead to independent proposal, support, applicability, and host-decision expectations.
ground_truth_method.matrix: The five active support states were crossed with the five active applicability states exactly once. Only supported plus applicable is admitted; every other ordinary cell abstains. Rejection and deliberate-deletion audit retention are specified as separate policy branches.
ground_truth_method.cardinality: Every retained source or candidate proposal has one and only one consumer decision link. The rejection corpus contains a concrete empty link collection and a concrete two-link collection with individually well-formed links.
ground_truth_method.rejection_derivation: Structural and policy rejects use exact JSON-pointer replacements with asserted old values against oracle.v9.json; cardinality rejects use exact structured link collections bound to real proposal identities.

excluded_inputs: Live or private fixtures and evidence
known_limitations: This public validation oracle establishes only the bounded semantic-admission expectations declared in oracle.v9.json.
It is not a private held-out verdict, reliability claim, readiness claim, or broader semantic generalization result.
The package does not authorize provider, credential, network, protected-root, or other external effects.
